UI_MaelstromMusic_ShowExampleStation_tt: Lists the bundled example station in the radio and TV presets. The station stays tunable by frequency when hidden.
UI_MaelstromMusic_GapMin_tt: After a background track ends, the mod stays silent for a random time between the shortest and the longest pause before the next one starts. Set both to 0 for back to back tracks.
UI_MaelstromMusic_GapMax_tt: Raised to the shortest pause if it is set lower.
UI_MaelstromMusic_StereoSafe_tt: Turn this on if radios and TVs go silent when you face them or turn your back to them. Some audio setups (typically PulseAudio or PipeWire on Linux) drop the centre and rear speakers of the game's 5.1 mix, so only sounds to your left and right are heard. This keeps every radio and TV audible from any direction and keeps the muffling through walls. Restart the current station or change track for it to apply.
UI_MaelstromMusic_ListenerFrame_tt: Screen: left and right follow the screen, like the base game. Player: left and right follow the way your character faces, for first person mods. Automatic picks Player when the Viewpoint mod is installed. Used by stereo safe positioning only.
